comments.author: @mariadow4618
comments.text:
I found this rather misleading.... at 11:24mins into this video, you mentioned  that this large pigeon with green and white chest was native to madeira island.  Well I can vouch for the fact that is the NZ Green  Pidgeon, the Kereru pidgeon. 
Please, please make sure your facts are correct.   Honesty goes a long way!

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: You are completely right, and we genuinely appreciate you calling this out, @mariadow4618! While Madeira is home to the endemic Trocaz pigeon, our editing team unfortunately pulled stock footage of the New Zealand Kererū by mistake. We take full responsibility for the error and are reinforcing our wildlife verification process. Thank you for your honesty!
